        if totalSum > B and diffVal < maxBucketVal:

        elif totalSum < B:

            segmentCount += 1

        if i == len(array) - 2 and pointerIdx < len(array) - 1:

            startIdx += 1
            evenCount = 0
            oddCount = 0
            continue
    i += 1

i = len(bucketsArr) - 1
while totalSum > B:
    if bucketsArr[i] > 0:
        totalSum -= i
        segmentCount -= 1
    else:
        i -= 1
